statement: ∀ (I : Finset ℕ) (K : ℕ) (b : ℕ → ℕ) (f : ℕ → ℂ) (r y : ℕ → ℝ) (G : ℕ → ℝ → ℂ), (∀ m ∈ I, b m < K) → (∀ m ∈ I, ‖f m‖ ≤ 1) → let B : ℕ → Finset ℕ := fun j => I.filter (fun m => b m = j); ‖∑ m ∈ I, f m * G m (r m)‖ ≤ ∑ j ∈ Finset.range K, ‖∑ m ∈ B j, f m * G m (y j)‖ + ∑ j ∈ Finset.range K, ∑ m ∈ B j, ‖G m (r m) - G m (y j)‖ ∧ (∑ j ∈ Finset.range K, Real.sqrt ((B j).card : ℝ)) ≤ Real.sqrt (K : ℝ) * Real.sqrt (I.card : ℝ)

plain_statement.zh: 移动上界分箱端点冻结分解与子箱长度平方根预算
plain_statement.en: Moving-cutoff bin-freezing decomposition and square-root bin cardinality budget

brief.zh: 按分箱映射将求和拆为互斥纤维，在每箱插入冻结端点项并用三角不等式估计差值；第二式对常数列与箱长平方根应用实数柯西不等式。
brief.en: Fiber the sum by the bin map, insert the frozen value on each fiber with the triangle inequality, and apply real Cauchy-Schwarz to ones against square-root fiber cardinalities.
